requirements.requirement: The system must expose a facade method in evaluate_care_facade that accepts a comparison request containing two or more provider identifiers.
The system must validate that the comparison request conforms to the Pydantic schema defined in EVAL-COMPARE-ST-001 before processing.
The system must call the provider comparison engine implemented in EVAL-COMPARE-ST-002 from the facade layer.
The system must return a structured comparison response matching the defined response schema without modification of field names or structure.
The system must register a tool endpoint in tool_router for provider comparison using the established tool registration pattern.
The system must ensure the tool endpoint invokes the evaluate_care_facade comparison method and not bypass the facade.
The system must serialize the comparison response into a JSON-compatible format for tool_router output.
The system must include ranked providers in the response ordered by computed comparison score.
The system must include per-provider measure breakdowns in the response payload.
The system must include strengths and weaknesses per provider in the response payload.
The system must return an error response when fewer than two provider identifiers are supplied.
The system must return an error response when the input schema validation fails.
The system must propagate domain errors from the comparison engine through the facade with a consistent error structure.
The system must ensure the tool endpoint is discoverable by the LLM via tool_router registration metadata.
The system must provide a tool description that clearly indicates the tool compares multiple providers.
The system must ensure the tool accepts structured arguments matching the comparison request schema.
The system must return deterministic output for identical inputs when invoked via the tool endpoint.
The system must not include unstructured natural language summaries in the tool response unless explicitly defined in the schema.
The system must ensure the LLM receives all providers included in the request in the response payload.
The system must preserve provider identifiers in the response for traceability.
The system must ensure the tool response is parseable without requiring post-processing by the LLM.
The system must handle duplicate provider identifiers in the request by either deduplicating or returning a validation error.
